**Install:** extract `coffeeflix.zip` to the root of your SD card, or put `coffeeflix.wuhb` in `sd:/wiiu/apps/coffeeflix/`. Requires Aroma.

**Tiramisu:** use `coffeeflix-tiramisu.zip` with the Homebrew Launcher.

`SHA256SUMS.txt` lists the package checksums. `release-manifest.json` records their source commit and hashes.

CoffeeFlix remains free. You can support development on [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/ubecatstudio).
